item.title: ישראל תופסת את מפקד חמאס בתקיפה בעזה, אמר שר הביטחון
item.description: ישראל כץ אומר שכוחות צה"ל תפסו את ראש הביטחון של חמאס מועין אל-ערביד במהלך פשיטה עמוקה בעזה, עם תקיפות אוויריות שכיסו את הנסיגה.

item.title: Trump says Iran is ‘DEAD’ — experts point to the real sign Tehran is nearing the brink
item.description: U.S. strikes on Iranian launchers near the Strait of Hormuz triggered ballistic missile retaliation as Brent crude climbed above $90 a barrel Monday.

item.title: New report exposes intact Iranian bunker that may hide regime's ongoing nuclear work
item.description: The bunkered Natanz structure was built between 2010 and 2017, raising urgent questions about Iran's uranium enrichment capabilities after two wars.

item.title: USS George Washington captain says morale is high for new Mideast mission
item.description: Ship's commanding office says morale is high on the USS George Washington as it replaces the USS Abraham Lincoln in the Middle East.

item.title: Trapped Nepali workers pulled from hydropower tunnel after catastrophic flooding
item.description: Video from Nepal's Prime Minister's Office shows rescue workers pulling trapped citizens through a mud-saturated hydropower plant tunnel in Rasuwa.

item.title: Russia threatens strikes on UK military targets, ‘catastrophic consequences’ over Ukraine
item.description: Russia threatened to strike British military targets inside and outside Ukraine after Moscow accused Kyiv of using Storm Shadow missiles against Donetsk.

item.title: Dominican Republic joins global fight against antisemitism with landmark move
item.description: Rabbi Yehuda Kaploun called the Dominican Republic's IHRA adoption a "historic moment" and urged other Latin American governments to follow suit.

item.title: Putin unleashes new fury on Ukraine as report exposes fear hanging over war’s end
item.description: Russia launched nearly 1,500 drones in four days as Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Moscow aims to exhaust Ukraine, with daytime attacks now disrupting Kyiv.

item.title: Nicolás Maduro flashes peace signs in first prison photos since US capture in Caracas
item.description: Ousted Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro appeared in his first photos from a New York prison, smiling as he awaits trial on federal drug trafficking charges.

item.title: Ex-Pentagon official urges US to ‘squeeze’ UK on defense amid Falklands furor
item.description: Morgan Murphy says U.S. neutrality on Falkland Islands sovereignty is unchanged but warns Washington may squeeze Britain on NATO defense spending.
